bugs_fixed.issue: GET /api/admin/users with plan=free filter caused MongoDB error: '$and/$or/$nor must be a nonempty array'
bugs_fixed.root_cause: When plan='free' and no search query, the code created an empty $or array and then tried to use $and with it, causing invalid MongoDB query
bugs_fixed.fix: Refactored the plan filter logic to properly handle the free plan condition without creating empty arrays

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all admin pages load and function correctly)
